method: Manual raster inspection of native A4 PDF pages at 200% root text size, from a dark screen theme; supplemented by automated bounds, label/value and paper-edge checks.

pages.finding: The residual bound and positive-regularization assumptions remain legible; the inverse and transpose marks are distinct.
All three visible result labels stay with their values; original-coordinate B and whitened A are consistent with the default example.
The corrected parameter/preprocessing distinction and surrounding formulas are fully visible.
Joint estimates, signed actual errors and the local standard deviation retain their degree units and complete values.
The variance formula, 2.44 standard-error ratio and 16.8 effective-sample example are visible with their independent-model caveat.
The extended class-K definition and quadratic-program constraints are legible.
The ceiling formula and fixed-policy IID interpretation are visible; the 2995-trial statement is complete.
The NeME table distinguishes classifier F1, policy meta-F1 and actual success; all cells fit and remain legible.

scope: Selected high-risk pages, not exhaustive visual review of every exported page or PDF/UA certification.

mobile_figures.finding: The full caption is visible and fits its figure container. Dense figure labels remain available through image zoom; nearby overflowing formulas and tables remain within their native scrolling regions.
